title.en: 180–220 mm stays on the Concrete Pump Prints a Slump Range page
title.zh: 180–220 mm仍写在哪台混凝土泵印了坍落度范围这一页

description.en: Concrete Pump Prints a Slump Range. 180–220 mm stays in the catalogue entry. Illustration: Simple machine.
description.zh: 哪台混凝土泵印了坍落度范围。180–220 mm仍在目录格子里。插图来自「简单机械」。

h1.en: 180–220 mm stays on the Concrete Pump Prints a Slump Range page
h1.zh: 180–220 mm仍写在哪台混凝土泵印了坍落度范围这一页

directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery lists a concrete slump entry on one pump in Xingtai: the Tractor-Driven 4100, 180–220 mm. Electric pumps, Diesel 30 through Diesel 120, LZ-60, LZ-80, both mixer pumps and the rural diesel pump do not list slump. The picture is from https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Simple_machine.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台只给一台泵标出了混凝土坍落度：拖拉机带动4100，为 180–220 mm。电动泵、柴油30到柴油120、LZ-60、LZ-80、两台搅拌泵和农村柴油泵都不标出坍落度。图片来自https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Simple_machine。

body.en: Downloaded from https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Simple_machine. The image subject is Six simple machines. Hebei Pinjin Machinery lists a concrete slump entry on one pump in Xingtai: the Tractor-Driven 4100, 180–220 mm. The tractor page labels the entry concrete slump and lists 180–220 mm. That is not 180–220 mm rewritten. A pump page without a slump row does not inherit 180–220 mm.
body.zh: 此图下载自https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Simple_machine。画面内容是Six simple machines。河北品锦机械在邢台只给一台泵标出了混凝土坍落度：拖拉机带动4100，为 180–220 mm。它旁边是功率 40 kW、产量 6–12 m³/h、距离 40–100 m / 15–45 m。请用 /zh/contact/ 并写明型号。

body.en: Electric pumps, Diesel 30 through Diesel 120, LZ-60, LZ-80, both mixer pumps and the rural diesel pump do not list slump. It sits beside power 40 kW, output 6–12 m³/h and distance 40–100 m / 15–45 m. Diesel 30 lists 20 MPa and no slump. Use /en/contact/ and name the model.
body.zh: 电动泵、柴油30到柴油120、LZ-60、LZ-80、两台搅拌泵和农村柴油泵都不标出坍落度。河北品锦机械没有在该页为另一种骨料再标出一个坍落度。不要把拖拉机这一格当成全公司的混凝土指标。

body.en: Pressure in MPa is not a slump figure. Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not list a second slump for a different aggregate on that page. Do not convert MPa into millimetres. Do not treat the tractor entry as a company-wide concrete specification.
body.zh: 如果配合比需要坍落度而页面没有这一格，格子就保持空白。这不是把 180–220 mm 换了一种写法。

body.en: If a mix specification needs slump and the page has no entry, the entry stays blank. The tractor also lists pumping pressure 15 MPa. The Xingtai sheets do not give a formula.
body.zh: 拖拉机页把这一格标为坍落度，写出 180–220 mm。没有坍落度行的泵页不能继承 180–220 mm。

answer.en: The Tractor-Driven 4100 concrete pump. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Simple_machine.
answer.zh: 拖拉机带动4100混凝土泵。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Simple_machine画面里印出的数字。

answer.en: No. Its sheet has output, pressure and distance rows, not a slump row. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Simple_machine.
answer.zh: 没有。它的参数页有产量、压力和距离，没有坍落度行。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Simple_machine画面里印出的数字。

question.en: Is 15 MPa the same as the slump entry?
question.zh: 15 MPa 和坍落度格是一回事吗？

answer.en: No. On the tractor page they are two entries, pumping pressure and concrete slump. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Simple_machine.
answer.zh: 不是。在拖拉机页上它们是两格：泵送压力和坍落度。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Simple_machine画面里印出的数字。

question.en: On this row: Can other pumps use 180–220 mm?
question.zh: 其他泵能使用 180–220 mm 吗？

answer.en: Only if that figure is shown on their page. In this catalogue it is not. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Simple_machine.
answer.zh: 只有它们的页面标出了这个数字才可以。在本目录里没有。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Simple_machine画面里印出的数字。
